'''January 2001 Greenwood tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Greenwood Park Mall, Greenwood, IN on 20 January 2001. It is known from Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1654">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-greenwood-in-1-20-01d1654/ greenwood-in-1-20-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-greenwood-in-1-20-01d1654/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Greenwood Park Mall, Greenwood, IN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 22
